newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Peak Performance sets up in France.
newsitem.headline: Peak Performance sets up in France.

text.p: Swedish clothing group Peak Performance, which listed on the Stockholm bourse last October, said on Tuesday it was setting up a subsidiary company in France.
Peak Performance, which specialises in outdoor sportswear and leisurewear, said it would concentrate its activities in France in the Alps region and northeast France.
Company spokesman Peter Blom told Reuters that Peak Performance has an office in Lyon and is looking for a site for a shop.

The company said Pierre Passalacqua, formerly of the U.S. sportswear company Wilson and of French skiwear company Degree 7, had been appointed director of French operations with two sales staff working with him.
Peak Performance was set up in 1986 in Are in Sweden, Scandinavia's largest ski resort, but is now based in Stockholm.
It has six shops in Sweden and two in Germany. It also has has one franchise shop in Norway with a second opening shortly, three in Switzerland and two in Denmark.
Asked about further European expansion, Blom said: "We are concentrating on these markets at the moment."
Peak Performance listed on the Stockholm bourse at a price of 135 crowns a share. At 1030 GMT it was trading 2.5 crowns higher on the day at 188 crowns.
